messages.content: Find the distance in kilometers from San Francisco to Los Angeles.

function.name: get_date
function.description: Get the time difference between two geographical locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: The unit of measure for the distance. Default is miles.

message.content:
**Distance from San Francisco to Los Angeles**

Using the great‑circle (Haversine) calculation on their latitude/longitude coordinates:

| City          | Latitude | Longitude |
|---------------|----------|-----------|
| San Francisco | 37.7749° N | –122.4194° W |
| Los Angeles   | 34.0522° N | –118.2437° W |

Plugging those into the Haversine formula gives an arc length of **≈ 558–562 km** (about **346–349 mi**) along Earth’s surface.  

If you prefer driving distances, the most common highways (I‑5 S / US‑101 S) cover roughly **615 km** (382 mi), depending on traffic and exact routing.
